description.value: This study used voxel-based morphometry and resting-state functional connectivity to characterize anatomical and functional cerebral deficits in codeine-containing cough syrup users compared with matched controls, and examined their relationships with impulsivity.

spans.text: To characterize the association between clinical symptoms and anatomical and functional cerebral deficits in codeine-containing cough syrups (CCS) users using voxel-based morphometry and resting state functional connectivity analysis.
